title: Restricted Fourier weight estimate from answers
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive integers $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. For a coordinate set $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, a subset $S\subseteq J$, and a sign-valued answer for each of the prescribed outer–inner query pairs, define the estimate as follows: for each outer sample, average the answers multiplied by the sign monomial indexed by $S$ on the corresponding inner free assignment; square this average, then average the squares over all outer samples.
hypotheses_covered: one sign-valued answer for each prescribed query pair
